headline: Ankle-to-knee S windswell on a marginal angle — dawn log session or skip.
today: Tiny short-period S swell, wrong angle for the peninsula, but the NNW offshore holds through the morning so it'll at least be clean. Grab a log and surf the early window before the SSW cross-on fills in around midday and the SSE onshore junks it up by evening. Nothing worth rearranging your morning for.

daysToWatch.note: Cleanest water of the stretch — SE at 7-10s is a good angle, just tiny at under a foot. NW cross-off morning is the window, log only.
S onshore ramping to 23mph all day. Blown out, don't bother.

Biggest of the week at 2-3ft with NW/NNW offshore, but short-period 4.6s on a marginal S angle so expect it soft and lumpy rather than lined up. Still your best size window — morning offshore is the call.
